title: RTPS: Added CRC32 and MD5 checksum check
description:
Added an option for checking the expected RTPS message
checksum is the same as the received in the wire if
checksum is CRC-32C or MD5

Not possible to use proto_tree_add_checksum ?

proto_tree_add_checksum only works with 8,16,24 and 32 bits checksums. In this case we would need 32, 64 (not supported yet but will be in the future) and 128 bits checksums. COuld be possible to use only for CRC-32C, but this way all cases are processed in the same way.

I could create a modified version of proto_tree_add_checksum function to support FT_BYTES checksum with an arbitrary number of bytes.
May be a good idea ? (Other ? what do you think ?)

The type of the checksum is only necessary to know the length and doing the comparison. I think could be useful having a function called proto_tree_add_checksum_bytes (or something similar) that receives a buffer of the computed checksum and the length as input parameters. Then the comparison can be done with memcmp. 

Apart of that the behaviour would be the same as the existing one.
Is it ok?
yes
I'm quite busy these days but I haven't forgot about this. I'll rake it as soon as i can.
Done. Added function proto_tree_add_checksum_bytes.

+/** Add a checksum bytes arry filed to a proto_tree.

+ @param computed_checksum Checksum as bytes array to verify against

commits_data.message:
RTPS: Added CRC32 and MD5 checksum check and deleted unused hfs

Added an option for checking the expected RTPS message
checksum is the same as the received in the wire if
checksum is CRC-32C or MD5. Also delted unused header filters.
Introduced function proto_tree_add_checksum_bytes.
